# `Scanner/T1Transmit-v0` · T1 in marked regions with an uncalibrated transmit field

**Status:** PRACTICE: its own gate rejects it (0 of 72 instances admitted; most frequent reason: fixed_recipe passes)

A hidden QA phantom (gel body and 4 to 7 vials) on the 3 T scanner. The agent must deliver T1 per marked region within a scan-time budget. The answer is wrong unless the transmit-field error is mapped and corrected and the gradient-echo protocol keeps spoiling errors small.

Every instance needs the same procedure, so one constant protocol passes. The admission gate rejects the environment for that reason; it stays as a practice task and as the worked example of the gate.

```python
import mrgym
env = mrgym.make("Scanner/T1Transmit-v0", level=2, seed=0)
obs, info = env.reset()
obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step({"name": "scanner_info", "arguments": {}})
```

| Given | Deliver | Scored by |
|---|---|---|
| A QA phantom with 4 to 7 vials, the scanner, a scan-time budget of 45 to 100 s | T1 of every marked vial, in ms | RMS relative T1 error against the hidden phantom; full marks inside the reference policy's own noise band |

## World

- On the table: QA phantom (disc of gel with vials), 3 T, body-coil receive
- Sequences that matter here: afi, spgr, ir
- Formulas the agent is given: ideal-spoiling Ernst / AFI closed forms (datasheet section 5); the served signal is the EPG steady state and deviates from them at short TR and weak spoilers

| Hidden (measurable only by scanning) | Told |
|---|---|
| geometry of body and vials | region centres and radii |
| PD, T1, T2, T2', diffusion coefficient per material | T1 prior range 300 to 2500 ms |
| B1+ pattern and transmit-gain error (8 to 25 %) | the instrument datasheet |
| B0 pattern and centre-frequency offset | budget and request limits |
| receive profile | realised protocol, timing, limits and cost of every plan and scan |
| inversion efficiency |  |
| noise level |  |
| the 128-bit world seed |  |

## Levels

| Level | Hidden-world prior | Budget (s) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | mild B1 non-uniformity (one global transmit-gain error dominates) | 60 to 100 |
| 2 | strong B1 non-uniformity (every region has its own flip-angle error) | 60 to 100 |
| 3 | strong B1 non-uniformity, tight budget, long T2 and slow diffusion (spoiling is hard) | 45 to 60 |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'units': 'ms', 't1_ms': {'<region id>': '<number>'}}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; deliverable valid: units "ms", exactly the region ids, values in 30 to 20000 ms
- Error: `E = sqrt(mean over regions of (T1_delivered / T1_true - 1)^2)`
- Score: `clip(ln(E_prior / E) / ln(E_prior / tol), 0, 1); E_prior = error of the no-scan answer; tol = max(2 x median, 1.25 x 95th percentile) of the reference policy's error over noise draws on this instance`
- Passing: E <= tol (reward 1)

## What the agent reads at reset (level 2, seed 0)

~~~text
# Measure T1 in marked regions with an uncalibrated transmit field

You operate a virtual MR scanner through tool calls. A test object of unknown composition lies in the field of view.
The transmit field is not calibrated: the flip angle a spin experiences is the nominal flip angle times an unknown,
position-dependent factor.

Deliver the longitudinal relaxation time T1 of each marked region, in milliseconds, with `submit`.

Regions (circles; centre and radius in mm from the isocentre; each lies inside one homogeneous material):
  R1   y    39.35 mm   x    40.38 mm   radius 11.50 mm
  R2   y   -14.79 mm   x   -55.63 mm   radius 11.50 mm
  R3   y   -57.51 mm   x    -8.30 mm   radius 11.50 mm
  R4   y    47.82 mm   x   -30.03 mm   radius 11.50 mm
  R5   y   -22.72 mm   x    52.67 mm   radius 11.50 mm

T1 values lie between 300 and 2500 ms. Nothing else about the object or the system is known.
Scoring: root-mean-square relative T1 error over the regions against the hidden truth. The scanner's log must show
that you measured. An answer in the wrong unit is wrong.

Budget: 62 s of scan time, counted by the scanner. At most 48 scanner requests (plans + scans) and 64 tool calls.
Tools: scanner_info (free); plan (free); scan (scan time); read_regions (free); view (free); submit (ends the episode).
~~~

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
